sourceContext: Follow-up authorization after the previous dispatch attempt failed because no valid existing Codex app-server thread could be proven for orchestrator-core. The human has already authorized autonomous completion of ORCHESTOR. This command explicitly authorizes safe creation or rebinding of exactly one valid persistent Codex app-server thread for orchestrator-core when no valid existing thread is available, then continuation of productization.
objective: Resolve the missing orchestrator-core Codex app-server thread binding safely, then continue the already-authorized ORCHESTOR productization autonomously to PROJECT_COMPLETE=YES or a genuine human safety gate.
why: The prior command was blocked only because the configured thread was not present in the local app-server registry. This is an expected bootstrap gap for a new reusable workstream and should not permanently stop autonomous completion.
scope: Treat CC-ORCHESTOR-PRODUCTIZE-20260930-02 as superseded by this command and CC-ORCHESTOR-CORE-COMPLETE-20260930-01 as historical/superseded. Do not dispatch either older command again.
Preserve the failed historical run ar_78dc2b7e-5346-4241-9b86-d5707c1e734e as immutable evidence. Do not mutate it back to RUNNING and do not reuse it as the active run for this command.
Inspect the local Codex app-server registry and current authenticated session state for a valid existing thread that can be proven to belong to workstream orchestrator-core.
If exactly one valid existing app-server thread can be proven for orchestrator-core, bind and reuse it.

If no valid existing app-server thread can be proven, explicitly authorize creation of exactly ONE new persistent Codex app-server thread for orchestrator-core using the existing authenticated Codex app-server/session path.
Do not create more than one new thread for orchestrator-core. Persist the binding atomically before dispatch.
If multiple ambiguous candidate threads exist and ownership cannot be proven, fail closed rather than guessing.
Create exactly one new durable run for this command after thread binding is valid. Enforce duplicate-run guards.
Restart the background daemon/watcher only through the previously certified zero-visible-window launcher and process policy.
Consume this command from the control plane, validate hash/identity, create the active run, perform FIRST_DISPATCH and persist dispatch acknowledgement.

After FIRST_DISPATCH, continue the full ORCHESTOR productization target from the previous command without further routine human prompts: standalone installable agent, ON/OFF/PAUSED/NEEDS_YOU UX, multi-project and multi-task isolation, external global state, concurrent safe task lanes, conflict serialization, restart recovery, notifications, zero-visible-windows, autonomous review/repair and final E2E certification.
Continue bounded autonomous implementation/test/review/repair loops until PROJECT_COMPLETE=YES or a genuine human approval/safety gate.
Do not modify Costa Clean application/product source.
outOfScope: Secrets, credentials, DNS, billing, payments or real external communications.
Privileged Windows service installation or system-wide policy changes.
Direct OpenAI API or OPENAI_API_KEY usage.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly one valid persistent Codex app-server thread is bound to orchestrator-core.
If a new thread is created, NEW_THREADS_CREATED_FOR_ORCHESTRATOR_CORE=1 and no duplicate/ambiguous live binding exists.
Old failed run ar_78dc2b7e-5346-4241-9b86-d5707c1e734e remains historical and is not reused as the active run.
Exactly one new active durable run is created for CC-ORCHESTOR-PRODUCTIZE-20260930-03.
The daemon/watch runtime remains zero-visible-window compliant.
The autonomous loop continues without routine copy/paste until PROJECT_COMPLETE=YES or a genuine human gate.
Final acceptance remains the full productization criteria from CC-ORCHESTOR-PRODUCTIZE-20260930-02.
Costa Clean application/product source mutations=0 and production/Supabase remote mutations=0.
requiredApprovals: Any Supabase or other remote database mutation.
Any secret/credential creation, rotation or disclosure.
Any DNS, billing, payment or real external communication.
Any material expansion beyond ORCHESTOR productization and non-production certification.
stopConditions: More than one ambiguous candidate existing thread cannot be safely disambiguated.
A second new orchestrator-core thread would be required after one new thread has already been created.
Zero-visible-window guarantees regress and cannot be repaired safely.
A forbidden or approval-required real-world side effect becomes necessary.
Bounded no-progress guards are exhausted with unresolved correctness/security findings.
verificationRequirements: Report THREAD_BINDING_SOURCE as EXISTING_VALID or NEW_CREATED.
Prove zero visible windows during thread bootstrap, dispatch and continued background operation.
Continue and complete all productization verification requirements from command 02.

Final report must include PROJECT_COMPLETE, INSTALLABLE_AGENT, UI_STATE_MODEL, MULTI_PROJECT, MULTI_TASK, CONFLICT_SERIALIZATION, MANUAL_COPY_PASTE_REQUIRED, ZERO_VISIBLE_WINDOWS, THREAD_POLICY, REVIEW_REPAIR_LOOP, RESTART_RECOVERY, HUMAN_GATES, NOTIFICATIONS, TESTS, FINAL_CERTIFICATION, APP_SOURCE_MUTATIONS, PRODUCTION_MUTATIONS and REMAINING_BLOCKERS.
